description: Published meetings, 25 a page: `id, title, length, URL`. Filter by `date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `year`, `body` (house-rules, senate-judiciary, house-floor), `chamber` (house or senate), or `kind` (floor, committee, rules); with no filter, the newest first and the list of bodies.

body.description: One body by its slug (house-rules, senate-judiciary, house-floor) or its name.
body.title: Body

kind.description: Kind of meeting: floor (a floor session), committee (a standing committee), or rules (the Rules Committee).
kind.title: Kind

limit.description: How many entries per page, 1 to 40 (default 25).
limit.title: Limit

start.description: How many entries to skip, as returned by the previous call's continuation pointer. 0 is the first page.
start.title: Start

year.description: One year (meetings are held from 2026 on).
year.title: Year

name: meetings_list
title: List House and Senate meetings
